name: University of Crete
summary: Public university on Crete; its one English-taught degree is a fee-paying six-year Medicine programme in Heraklion, taught by the Medical School.

ib.text: The English-taught Medicine takes the IB Diploma directly: three HL subjects, two of them from Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Maths, plus three SL; no points total is stated.

lastYear.text: early round in November; regular round in March

programmes.name: International Program in Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year medical programme taught and examined in English: basic and pre-clinical cycles, then clinical clerkships from semester 9, with Greek lessons to B2 level so you can talk to patients.
programmes.ib: IB with three HL subjects, two from Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Maths, and three SL; B2 English (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79); motivation letter, CV and online interview.

needs.note: Two of these at HL, inside three HL subjects in total

programmes.selectionNote: Early round (deadline in November) has a limited number of places; the regular round closes in March. About four times the places are invited to an online interview.

lastYear.text: early round in November; regular round in March

notes: Open only to non-Greek citizens who attended their last two years of secondary school outside Greece; Greek-taught places go through the Ministry of Education instead.
A €3,000 non-refundable down payment secures an offer, then €6,000 is due by the end of June; scholarships of €2,000 go to the three best students each year.
All teaching is in English, but the programme gives Greek courses so students reach B2 by the end of the pre-clinical cycle, because clinical training is with Greek-speaking patients.
